source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "F3" to return the settings to default values

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify that the board-defined F3 Optimized Defaults function loads the approved default BIOS profile and presents the expected confirmation behavior.
original_method: Capture the complete relevant BIOS configuration, press F3 in setup, visually compare the loaded values to the approved defaults, then cancel or save/reboot only under the preapproved plan and verify the final platform state.
manual_activity: A qualified human must trigger F3, inspect the broad set of loaded defaults and confirmation UI, and control whether the changes are canceled or committed.
required_inputs: Pre-test BIOS configuration export or complete capture
safety_requirements: One authorized-user approval may cover the unchanged plan.
Do not save or reboot with defaults unless explicitly included in that plan.
Protect boot, secure boot/TPM, storage mode, thermal, power and performance settings.
Stop on an unknown difference or missing recovery path.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare configuration baselines/diff and recovery checklist.
Collect read-only OS/BMC context and post-action evidence if supplied.
Highlight deviations without driving the UI or deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the default reference, persistence choice and recovery plan.
Perform and visually inspect the F3 operation.
Restore or validate the final configuration and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct that SSH cannot execute or observe the F3 BIOS UI action, but it omits the configuration-wide risk.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the interactive method and add an approved configuration export/diff; do not substitute a factory-reset command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F3, optimized defaults and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture an auditable pre-state, F3 prompt, loaded-default diff, explicit persistence decision and post-state/recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board and BIOS build with its published/project-approved default map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds configuration-wide comparison, explicit commit boundary and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; a CLI inventory cannot replace F3 UI behavior or full default-profile verification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Defaults may break boot, storage or security assumptions.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve observation-only cancel or a persistent default load; evidence must state which plan ran and must not claim the other path was tested.
expected_evidence: Timestamped F3 prompt and loaded-value comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests F3 optimized defaults. Missing platform default values and persistence policy are project inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended operation is clear; execution waits for configuration/reference/recovery inputs rather than making the library case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual UI operation but understates blast radius.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its configuration-wide safeguards and human classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Clarifies one-approval plan scope, execution status, tool result and engineer verdict separation.

review_improvement: Reframes F3 from a simple function-key check into a controlled whole-configuration transition while preserving the original key and intent.
independent_technical_reasoning: Optimized defaults can alter many coupled settings; the UI prompt and value set require qualified visual review and an explicit commit decision. Supporting diffs may be automated, but the acceptance core is MANUAL ONLY.

source_provenance.history: Repository exact-code search and distinct row 1458 flash variant

no_automatic_retry: Do not press F3 again, confirm, save or reboot automatically after any unexpected value or prompt; preserve state and stop.
